sentences.text: Heard Mr. R. K. Agarwala, learned counsel appearing for the writ petitioner.
Also heard Mr. B. Chakraborty, learned counsel appearing for the respondent Nos.1 and 2.

The impugned notification dated 23.09.2020 (Annexure-II) has already been suspended by the High Court of Delhi at New Delhi by order dated 29.09.2020 passed in connection with W.P.(C)
7217/2020 and CM 24381/2020.

entities.text: High Court of Delhi at New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Since the notification has already been stayed, hence, there cannot be any impediment on the part of the petitioner to operate the unit.
However, despite stay of the impugned notification, Mr. Agarwala submits that the authorities have asked each unit to obtain separate orders from the Court so as to resume operation.
Mr. Agarwala submits that insistence on such an order would be wholly arbitrary.
Mr. Chakraborty, learned counsel for the respondent Nos.1 and 2, prays for posting this matter again on 19.10.2020 so as to enable him to obtain instruction.
